title_orig: Risālat al-Hāshimī ilā ʿAbd al-Masīḥ ibn Isḥāq al-Kindī wa-risālat al-Kindī ilā al-Hāshimī
title_es: Carta de al-Hāšimī a al-Kindī y respuesta de al-Kindī: título de trabajo
title_en: Letter of al-Hashimi to al-Kindi and al-Kindi's reply (my title translation)
date: 9th c. CE; OpenITI header: 247 AH / 861 CE (editor's claim, not verified by me)
edition_original: Not identified in the OpenITI header. Two OpenITI copies read: Kalema00001 (alkalema.net source) and SyriacStudies00001 (cross-check).
licence: OpenITI header only; the alkalema.net page was not opened, so no licence line was read.
authenticity_note: Authorship: OpenITI lists "Anonymous"; title attributes the reply to al-Kindi. Header cites Van Koningsveld 2004 for dating (not read). Disputed attribution and date.
notes: Christian reply; outside the core brief. The Hashimi letter (Muslim side) contains a legal rule on four wives (excluded.json) and no reply to the age charge that I found. Read: Kalema copy chars ~24,000–25,000 and ~54,700–57,400.
